The '''Khormai environment suit''' was an [[Environment suit/Legends|environment suit]] worn by members of the [[Khormai/Legends|Khormai]] [[Species/Legends|species]] on their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], [[Khorm/Legends|Khorm]]. The suits were [[Color/Legends|orange]] in color and featured numerous pipes and tubes. One large pipe extended from behind the wearer's head, where it belched plumes of gray [[Atmosphere/Legends|gas]].
